assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are repository provisional rough polygons derived from announcement text. They are not official redlines and cannot support ownership, approval, or precise-area conclusions.
assumptions.impact: After official polygons are released, all nine geometry layers, all area metrics, all five figures, both drawing sets, and both HTML deliverables must be re-cut and recomputed in EPSG:4548, and self-check must be rerun.

assumptions.statement: No official, parcel-level inventory of underused or idle space along the belt is publicly available. The reported ~1,000,000 sqm renewable-space figure is a media-reported context value, not an approved ledger.
assumptions.impact: The proposal therefore specifies the ledger's fields, registration workflow, verification roles, and stop conditions instead of fabricating a parcel list. Phase 1 output is the verified ledger itself; all downstream matching and pilot decisions wait for verified entries.

assumptions.statement: Global and domestic cases (Station F, King's Cross, Block71, Newlab, MaRS, Mosu Space, Zhongkun Plaza, 768 Park, Petroleum Compound) are used only for mechanism comparison. Their scale, rents, governance structures, and performance indicators are not transferred to this site.
assumptions.impact: Case-derived mechanisms must be re-validated against local ownership, market, and regulatory conditions by professional teams before any implementation decision.

assumptions.statement: The six concept building footprints and their floor counts are wake-prototype placeholders for spatial reasoning, not surveyed buildings, approved massing, or demolition/retention conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Statutory floor area, density, and height conclusions cannot be derived from these placeholders; they are marked as low-confidence concept quantities only.

assumptions.statement: Media reports state the heritage park phase 2 opened on 2026-08-06 as a continuous 9 km corridor. The park band in constraints.geojson is an indicative alignment, not the surveyed park boundary.
assumptions.impact: Interface design along the park treats the corridor as built and locked; exact edge conditions require surveyed park boundaries and management-unit confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All ledger, matching, pilot admission, and honor-display mechanisms are conceptual operating suggestions. AI systems in the loop only retrieve, match, simulate, and summarize; ownership, safety, approval, procurement, and public-interest judgments remain with authorized humans and professional teams.
assumptions.impact: No mechanism in this proposal may be read as an approved government arrangement, funding commitment, or statutory procedure.
